verses.original: יְהוָ֥ה אֶת־ וַיַּ֖עַן אִיּ֗וֹב וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ’eṯ- way·ya·‘an ’î·yō·wḇ way·yō·mar
verses.literal: And the LORD said to Job . . .

verses.original: יִסּ֑וֹר הֲ֭רֹב עִם־ שַׁדַּ֣י מוֹכִ֖יחַ אֱל֣וֹהַּ יַעֲנֶֽנָּה׃פ
verses.transliteration: yis·sō·wr hă·rōḇ ‘im- šad·day mō·w·ḵî·aḥ ’ĕ·lō·w·ah ya·‘ă·nen·nāh
verses.literal: Will the faultfinder contend with the Almighty Let him who argues with God give an answer

verses.original: אִיּ֥וֹב אֶת־ וַיַּ֖עַן יְהוָ֗ה וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ’î·yō·wḇ ’eṯ- way·ya·‘an Yah·weh way·yō·mar
verses.literal: Then Job - answered the LORD . . .

verses.original: הֵ֣ן קַ֭לֹּתִי מָ֣ה אֲשִׁיבֶ֑ךָּ שַׂ֣מְתִּי יָ֝דִ֗י לְמוֹ־ פִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: hên qal·lō·ṯî māh ’ă·šî·ḇe·kā śam·tî yā·ḏî lə·mōw- p̄î
verses.literal: Behold I am insignificant How can I reply to You I place my hand over my mouth

verses.original: דִּ֭בַּרְתִּי אַחַ֣ת וְלֹ֣א אֶֽעֱנֶ֑ה וּ֝שְׁתַּ֗יִם וְלֹ֣א אוֹסִֽיף׃פ
verses.transliteration: dib·bar·tî ’a·ḥaṯ wə·lō ’e·‘ĕ·neh ū·šə·ta·yim wə·lō ’ō·w·sîp̄
verses.literal: I have spoken once but I have no answer twice but I have nothing to add

verses.original: יְהוָ֣ה אֶת־ וַיַּֽעַן־ אִ֭יּוֹב מִנ סְעָרָה וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ’eṯ- way·ya·‘an- ’î·yō·wḇ min sə·ʿå̄·rå̄h way·yō·mar
verses.literal: Then the LORD answered Job out of the whirlwind and said

verses.original: נָ֣א אֱזָר־ חֲלָצֶ֑יךָ כְגֶ֣בֶר אֶ֝שְׁאָלְךָ֗ וְהוֹדִיעֵֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: nā ’ĕ·zār- ḥă·lā·ṣe·ḵā ḵə·ḡe·ḇer ’eš·’ā·lə·ḵā wə·hō·w·ḏî·‘ê·nî
verses.literal: Now brace yourself like a man I will question you and you shall inform Me

verses.original: הַ֭אַף תָּפֵ֣ר מִשְׁפָּטִ֑י תַּ֝רְשִׁיעֵ֗נִי לְמַ֣עַן תִּצְדָּֽק׃
verses.transliteration: ha·’ap̄ tā·p̄êr miš·pā·ṭî tar·šî·‘ê·nî lə·ma·‘an tiṣ·dāq
verses.literal: Would you really annul My justice Would you condemn Me to justify yourself?

verses.original: וְאִם־ זְר֖וֹעַ כָּאֵ֥ל׀ לָ֑ךְ תַרְעֵֽם׃ וּ֝בְק֗וֹל כָּמֹ֥הוּ
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- zə·rō·w·a‘ kā·’êl lāḵ ṯar·‘êm ū·ḇə·qō·wl kā·mō·hū
verses.literal: - Do you have an arm like God’s Can you thunder with a voice like His

verses.original: נָ֣א עֲדֵ֥ה גָֽא֣וֹן וָגֹ֑בַהּ תִּלְבָּֽשׁ׃ וְה֖וֹד וְהָדָ֣ר
verses.transliteration: nā ‘ă·ḏêh ḡå̄·ʾōn wā·ḡō·ḇah til·bāš wə·hō·wḏ wə·hā·ḏār
verses.literal: Then adorn yourself [with] majesty and splendor and clothe yourself with honor and glory

verses.original: הָ֭פֵץ עֶבְר֣וֹת אַפֶּ֑ךָ וּרְאֵ֥ה כָל־ גֵּ֝אֶ֗ה וְהַשְׁפִּילֵֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: hā·p̄êṣ ‘eḇ·rō·wṯ ’ap·pe·ḵā ū·rə·’êh ḵāl gê·’eh wə·haš·pî·lê·hū
verses.literal: Unleash the fury of your wrath look on every proud man and bring him low

verses.original: רְאֵ֣ה כָל־ גֵּ֭אֶה הַכְנִיעֵ֑הוּ וַהֲדֹ֖ךְ רְשָׁעִ֣ים תַּחְתָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: rə·’êh ḵāl gê·’eh haḵ·nî·‘ê·hū wa·hă·ḏōḵ rə·šā·‘îm taḥ·tām
verses.literal: Look on every proud man and humble him trample the wicked where they stand

verses.original: טָמְנֵ֣ם יָ֑חַד פְּ֝נֵיהֶ֗ם בֶּעָפָ֣ר חֲבֹ֣שׁ בַּטָּמֽוּן׃
verses.transliteration: ṭā·mə·nêm yā·ḥaḏ pə·nê·hem be·‘ā·p̄ār ḥă·ḇōš baṭ·ṭā·mūn
verses.literal: Bury them together . . . in the dust imprison them in the grave

verses.original: וְגַם־ אֲנִ֥י אוֹדֶ֑ךָּ כִּֽי־ יְמִינֶֽךָ׃ תוֹשִׁ֖עַ לְךָ֣
verses.transliteration: wə·ḡam- ’ă·nî ’ō·w·ḏe·kā kî- yə·mî·ne·ḵā ṯō·wō·ši·a‘ lə·ḵā
verses.literal: Then I will confess to you that your own right hand can save you

verses.original: הִנֵּה־ נָ֣א בְ֭הֵמוֹת אֲשֶׁר־ עָשִׂ֣יתִי עִמָּ֑ךְ יֹאכֵֽל׃ חָ֝צִ֗יר כַּבָּקָ֥ר
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh- nā ḇə·hê·mō·wṯ ’ă·šer- ‘ā·śî·ṯî ‘im·māḵ yō·ḵêl ḥā·ṣîr kab·bā·qār
verses.literal: Look at . . . Behemoth which I made [along] with you He feeds on grass like an ox

verses.original: הִנֵּה־ נָ֣א כֹח֣וֹ בְמָתְנָ֑יו וְ֝אֹנ֗וֹ בִּשְׁרִירֵ֥י בִטְנֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh- nā ḵō·ḥōw ḇə·mā·ṯə·nāw wə·’ō·nōw biš·rî·rê ḇiṭ·nōw
verses.literal: See . . . the strength of his loins and the power in the muscles of his belly

verses.original: זְנָב֣וֹ יַחְפֹּ֣ץ כְמוֹ־ אָ֑רֶז גִּידֵ֖י פַחֲדוֹ יְשֹׂרָֽגוּ׃
verses.transliteration: zə·nā·ḇōw yaḥ·pōṣ ḵə·mōw- ’ā·rez gî·ḏê p̄a·ḥă·ḏō yə·śō·rā·ḡū
verses.literal: His tail sways like a cedar the sinews of his thighs are tightly knit

verses.original: עֲ֭צָמָיו אֲפִיקֵ֣י נְחוּשָׁ֑ה גְּ֝רָמָ֗יו כִּמְטִ֥יל בַּרְזֶֽל׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ă·ṣā·māw ’ă·p̄î·qê nə·ḥū·šāh gə·rā·māw kim·ṭîl bar·zel
verses.literal: His bones are tubes of bronze his limbs are rods of iron

verses.original: ה֭וּא רֵאשִׁ֣ית אֵ֑ל דַּרְכֵי־ הָ֝עֹשׂוֹ חַרְבּֽוֹ׃ יַגֵּ֥שׁ
verses.transliteration: hū rê·šîṯ ’êl dar·ḵê- hā·‘ō·śōw ḥar·bōw yag·gêš
verses.literal: He is the foremost of God’s works only his Maker can draw the sword against him

verses.original: כִּֽי־ הָרִ֣ים יִשְׂאוּ־ ל֑וֹ ב֭וּל וְֽכָל־ חַיַּ֥ת הַ֝שָּׂדֶ֗ה יְשַֽׂחֲקוּ־ שָֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: kî- hā·rîm yiś·’ū- lōw ḇūl wə·ḵāl ḥay·yaṯ haś·śā·ḏeh yə·śa·ḥă·qū- šām
verses.literal: - The hills yield him their produce while all the beasts of the field play nearby

verses.original: יִשְׁכָּ֑ב תַּֽחַת־ צֶאֱלִ֥ים בְּסֵ֖תֶר קָנֶ֣ה וּבִצָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: yiš·kāḇ ta·ḥaṯ- ṣe·’ĕ·lîm bə·sê·ṯer qā·neh ū·ḇiṣ·ṣāh
verses.literal: He lies under the lotus plants hidden among the reeds of the marsh

verses.original: צֶאֱלִ֣ים יְסֻכֻּ֣הוּ צִֽלֲל֑וֹ עַרְבֵי־ נָֽחַל׃ יְ֝סֻבּ֗וּהוּ
verses.transliteration: ṣe·’ĕ·lîm yə·suk·ku·hū ṣi·lă·lōw ‘ar·ḇê- nā·ḥal yə·sub·bū·hū
verses.literal: The lotus plants conceal him in their shade the willows of the brook surround him

verses.original: הֵ֤ן נָ֭הָר יַעֲשֹׁ֣ק לֹ֣א יַחְפּ֑וֹז יִבְטַ֓ח׀ כִּֽי־ יַרְדֵּ֣ן יָגִ֖יחַ אֶל־ פִּֽיהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: hên nā·hār ya·‘ă·šōq lō yaḥ·pō·wz yiḇ·ṭaḥ kî- yar·dên yā·ḡî·aḥ ’el- pî·hū
verses.literal: Though the river rages Behemoth is unafraid . . . he remains secure though the Jordan surges to his mouth

verses.original: יִקָּחֶ֑נּוּ בְּעֵינָ֥יו יִנְקָב־ אָֽף׃ בְּ֝מֽוֹקְשִׁ֗ים
verses.transliteration: yiq·qā·ḥen·nū bə·‘ê·nāw yin·qāḇ- ’āp̄ bə·mō·wq·šîm
verses.literal: Can anyone capture him as he looks on or pierce his nose with a snare
